label: Action Permission
definition: A Process Regulation that permits some Process.
definition_enriched: An Action Permission is a Process Regulation that permits some Process.

label: Affordance
definition: A Realizable Entity of an Independent Continuant that creates an opportunity for an Agent to realize some Agent Capability or Disposition in some Act.
definition_enriched: An Affordance is a Realizable Entity of an Independent Continuant that creates an opportunity for an Agent to realize some Agent Capability or Disposition in some Act.

label: Agent
definition: A Material Entity that bears an Agent Capability.
definition_enriched: An Agent is a Material Entity that bears an Agent Capability.

label: Agent Capability
definition: A Realizable Entity that inheres in a Material Entity in virtue of that Material Entity's capacity to realize it in some Planned Act.
definition_enriched: An Agent Capability is a Realizable Entity that inheres in a Material Entity in virtue of that Material Entity's capacity to realize the Agent Capability in some Planned Act.

label: Allegiance Role
definition: A Role that inheres in an Agent by virtue of the support it has committed to provide to another Agent when that Agent is involved in a conflict.
definition_enriched: An Allegiance Role is a Role that inheres in an Agent by virtue of the support that Agent has committed to provide to another Agent when the other Agent is involved in a conflict.

label: Allied Person
definition: A Person who is the bearer of some Ally Role.
definition_enriched: An Allied Person is a Person that is the bearer of some Ally Role.

label: Ally Role
definition: An Allegiance Role that inheres in an Agent in virtue of that Agent's commitment to perform Acts that support the Objectives of a particular Agent or Group of Agents.
definition_enriched: An Ally Role is an Allegiance Role that inheres in an Agent in virtue of that Agent's commitment to perform Acts that support the Objectives of a particular Agent or Group of Agents.

label: Animal
definition: An Organism that is multicellular, eukaryotic, heterotrophic, and capable of motility for part of its life.
definition_enriched: An Animal is an Organism that is multicellular, eukaryotic, heterotrophic, and capable of motility for part of its life.

label: Armed Force
definition: An Organization having the Objective to further the foreign and domestic policies of a Government and to defend that body and the nation it represents from external and internal aggressors.
definition_enriched: An Armed Force is an Organization that has the Objective to further the foreign and domestic policies of a Government and to defend that Government and the nation it represents from external and internal aggressors.

label: Authority Role
definition: A Role that is realized by Processes which create, modify, transfer, or eliminate Process Regulations or other Authority Roles, and inheres in an Agent in virtue of collective acceptance of that Agent's ability to issue binding directives.
definition_enriched: An Authority Role is a Role that inheres in an Agent in virtue of collective acceptance of that Agent's ability to issue binding directives and that is realized by Processes which create, modify, transfer, or eliminate Process Regulations or other Authority Roles.

label: Biological Sex
definition: A Quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ability to undergo sexual reproduction in order to differentiate the individuals or types involved.
definition_enriched: Biological Sex is a Quality that inheres in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's ability to undergo sexual reproduction in order to differentiate the individuals or types involved.

label: Bodily Component
definition: A Fiat Object Part located within or on the surface of an Agent.
definition_enriched: A Bodily Component is a Fiat Object Part that is located within or on the surface of an Agent.

label: Carrier Air Wing
definition: A Military Force that is trained and equipped to conduct air operations while embarked on an aircraft carrier.
definition_enriched: A Carrier Air Wing is a Military Force that is trained and equipped to conduct air operations while embarked on an aircraft carrier.

label: Citizen
definition: A Person who is the bearer of some Citizen Role.
definition_enriched: A Citizen is a Person that is the bearer of some Citizen Role.

label: Citizen Role
definition: A Role that inheres in a Person by virtue of that Person being legally recognized as a member of a particular state, with associated rights and obligations.
definition_enriched: Citizen Role is a Role that inheres in a Person by virtue of that Person being legally recognized as a member of a particular state, with associated rights and obligations.

label: City
definition: A Local Administrative Region in which a relatively large human population permanently resides; is designated as a city based on a particular administrative, legal, or historical status; and which delimits a local Government that typically oversees the provision of systems for sanitation, utilities, land usage, housing, and transportation.
definition_enriched: A City is a Local Administrative Region in which a relatively large human population permanently resides, that is designated as a city based on a particular administrative, legal, or historical status, and that delimits a local Government that typically oversees the provision of systems for sanitation, utilities, land usage, housing, and transportation.

label: Civil Organization
definition: An Organization that is not commercial or military and is the bearer of a Civilian Role.
definition_enriched: A Civil Organization is an Organization that is neither commercial nor military and is the bearer of a Civilian Role.

label: Civilian Role
definition: A Role that inheres in an Agent or Group of Agents by virtue of that Agent or Group of Agents not being part of either an Armed Force or police force.
definition_enriched: Civilian Role is a Role that inheres in an Agent or Group of Agents by virtue of that Agent or Group of Agents not being part of either an Armed Force or a police force.

label: Commercial Organization
definition: An Organization that is the bearer of a Commercial Role and whose primary objective is to make a profit from the provision of goods or services.
definition_enriched: A Commercial Organization is an Organization that is the bearer of a Commercial Role and whose primary objective is to make a profit from the provision of goods or services.

label: Commercial Role
definition: A Role that inheres in an Organization by virtue of its establishment as a for-profit business.
definition_enriched: A Commercial Role is a Role that inheres in an Organization by virtue of that Organization's establishment as a for-profit business.

label: Constituent State
definition: A First-Order Administrative Region that is part of a Country and delimits a centralized regional Government that holds constitutionally-defined administrative jurisdiction over the defined geographic territory that bounds the State.
definition_enriched: A Constituent State is a First-Order Administrative Region that is part of a Country and delimits a centralized regional Government that holds constitutionally-defined administrative jurisdiction over the defined geographic territory that bounds the Constituent State.

label: Contractor Role
definition: A Role that inheres in an Agent or Group of Agents by virtue of that Agent or Group of Agents entering into a Contract to provide materials or labor to perform a service or complete a task.
definition_enriched: A Contractor Role is a Role that inheres in an Agent or Group of Agents by virtue of that Agent or Group of Agents entering into a Contract to provide materials or labor to perform a service or complete a task.

label: County
definition: A Government Domain that is part of either a First-Order or Second-Order Administrative Region.
definition_enriched: A County is a Government Domain that is part of either a First-Order Administrative Region or a Second-Order Administrative Region.

label: Crew
definition: A Group of Persons that bear Roles realized by the operation of the specified Vehicle.
definition_enriched: A Crew is a Group of Persons that bear Roles realized by the operation of the specified Vehicle.

label: Delimiting Domain
definition: A Geospatial Region that delimits the authority of an Organization to exercise its control within the bounded area.
definition_enriched: A Delimiting Domain is a Geospatial Region that delimits the authority of an Organization to exercise its control within the bounded area.

label: Disability
definition: A Quality inhering in an Agent by virtue a physical or mental condition that limits the Agent's movements, senses, or activities.
definition_enriched: Disability is a Quality that inheres in an Agent by virtue of a physical or mental condition that limits the Agent's movements, senses, or activities.

label: Disease
definition: A Disposition to undergo pathological processes that exists in an organism because of one or more disorders in that organism.
definition_enriched: Disease is a disposition to undergo pathological processes that exists in an organism because of one or more disorders in that organism.

label: Division of Delimiting Domain
definition: A Geospatial Region that is a fiat division of a Delimiting Domain and not a Delimiting Domain.
definition_enriched: A Division of Delimiting Domain is a Geospatial Region that is a fiat division of a Delimiting Domain and is not a Delimiting Domain.

label: Domain of a Country
definition: A Government Domain that is associated with certain distinct political, ethnic, or cultural characteristics, and which delimits a Government that has legitimate authority over a Populace.
definition_enriched: A Domain of a Country is a Government Domain that is associated with certain distinct political, ethnic, or cultural characteristics and that delimits a Government that has legitimate authority over a Populace.

label: Educational Organization
definition: An Organization whose primary purpose is to provide training or otherwise facilitate learning or the acquisition of knowledge, Skills, values, beliefs, or habits.
definition_enriched: An Educational Organization is an Organization whose primary purpose is to provide training or otherwise facilitate learning or the acquisition of knowledge, Skills, values, beliefs, or habits.

label: Enemy Person
definition: A Person who is the bearer of some Enemy Role.
definition_enriched: An Enemy Person is a Person that is the bearer of some Enemy Role.

label: Enemy Role
definition: An Allegiance Role that inheres in an Agent by virtue of that Agent having committed offensive Acts or exhibited intent to perform such Acts towards a particular Agent or Group of Agents or has been declared as hostile by some appropriate authority.
definition_enriched: An Enemy Role is an Allegiance Role that inheres in an Agent in virtue of that Agent having committed offensive Acts or exhibited intent to perform such Acts towards a particular Agent or Group of Agents, or having been declared as hostile by some appropriate authority.

label: Ethnic Group
definition: A Group of Persons who identify with one another based on one or more shared inherited characteristics such as language, ancestry, nationality, culture, customs, religion, or social experiences.
definition_enriched: An Ethnic Group is a Group of Persons who identify with one another based on one or more shared inherited characteristics such as language, ancestry, nationality, culture, customs, religion, or social experiences.

label: Ethnicity
definition: A Quality that inheres in its bearers by virtue of a common heritage, often consisting of a common language, a common culture (often including a shared religion) and an ideology that stresses common ancestry or endogamy.
definition_enriched: Ethnicity is a Quality that inheres in its bearers by virtue of a common heritage, often consisting of a common language, a common culture (often including a shared religion), and an ideology that stresses common ancestry or endogamy.

label: Eye
definition: A Bodily Component that consists of an organ that canonically affords the Agent it is part of with the ability to receive visual stimuli necessary for sight.
definition_enriched: An Eye is a Bodily Component that consists of an organ that canonically affords the Agent of which it is a part the ability to receive visual stimuli necessary for sight.

label: Eye Color
definition: A Quality inhering in an Eye by virtue of the color of the Eye's Iris.
definition_enriched: Eye Color is a Quality that inheres in an Eye by virtue of the color of that Eye's Iris.

label: Facial Hair
definition: A Bodily Component that consists of a portion of hair that grows on the face of a human (typically male) or other animal.
definition_enriched: Facial Hair is a Bodily Component that consists of a portion of hair that grows on the face of a human (typically male) or other animal.

label: Family
definition: A Group of Persons related to one another by ancestry or marriage.
definition_enriched: A Family is a Group of Persons that are related to one another by ancestry or marriage.

label: Female Sex
definition: A Biological Sex inhering in an individual that only produces gametes that can be fertilized by male gametes.
definition_enriched: Female Sex is a Biological Sex that inheres in an individual that produces only gametes that can be fertilized by male gametes.

label: Financial Value
definition: A quality that inheres in an independent continuant to the degree that that independent continuant can serve as a medium of exchange in an economic system at a particular time.
definition_enriched: Financial Value is a quality that inheres in an independent continuant to the degree that the independent continuant can serve as a medium of exchange in an economic system at a particular time.

label: Financial Value of Property
definition: Financial Value that inheres in an material entity that is the object of an Act of Ownership.
definition_enriched: Financial Value of Property is a Financial Value that inheres in a material entity that is the object of an Act of Ownership.

label: First-Order Administrative Region
definition: A Government Domain that is a primary administrative division of a Country.
definition_enriched: A First-Order Administrative Region is a Government Domain that is a primary administrative division of a Country.

label: Fourth-Order Administrative Region
definition: A Government Domain that is a subdivision of a Third-Order Administrative Region.
definition_enriched: A Fourth-Order Administrative Region is a Government Domain that is a subdivision of a Third-Order Administrative Region.

label: Geopolitical Organization
definition: An Organization that bears a Geopolitical Power Role.
definition_enriched: A Geopolitical Organization is an Organization that bears a Geopolitical Power Role.

label: Geopolitical Power Role
definition: A Role had by an Organization, that is perceived by an International Community as capable of performing influential acts in that community, and which would be realized in performing such acts.
definition_enriched: A Geopolitical Power Role is a Role that is had by an Organization, is perceived by an International Community as capable of performing influential acts in that community, and would be realized in performing such acts.

label: Government
definition: An Organization that is the highest legitimate authority delimited by some Delimiting Domain and that exercises executive, legislative, or judicial authority in that Domain.
definition_enriched: A Government is an Organization that is the highest legitimate authority delimited by some Delimiting Domain and that exercises executive, legislative, or judicial authority in that Delimiting Domain.

label: Government Domain
definition: A Delimiting Domain that delimits the authority of a Government to exercise its control within the bounded area.
definition_enriched: A Government Domain is a Delimiting Domain that delimits the authority of a Government to exercise its control within the bounded area.

label: Government Domain Border
definition: A One-Dimensional Geospatial Boundary of some Government Domain.
definition_enriched: A Government Domain Border is a One-Dimensional Geospatial Boundary of some Government Domain.

label: Government Organization
definition: An Organization that is part of a Government and is responsible for the oversight or administration of specific governmental functions.
definition_enriched: A Government Organization is an Organization that is part of a Government and is responsible for the oversight or administration of specific governmental functions.

label: Government of a Country
definition: A Government that has legitimate authority within and is delimited by a Domain of a Country.
definition_enriched: A Government of a Country is a Government that has legitimate authority within and is delimited by a Domain of a Country.

label: Group of Agents
definition: An Object Aggregate that has only Agents as member parts.
definition_enriched: A Group of Agents is an Object Aggregate that has only Agents as member parts.

label: Group of Organizations
definition: A Group of Agents that has only Organizations as member parts.
definition_enriched: A Group of Organizations is a Group of Agents that has only Organizations as member parts.

label: Group of Persons
definition: A Group of Agents that has only Persons as member parts.
definition_enriched: A Group of Persons is a Group of Agents that has only Persons as member parts.

label: Hair Color
definition: A Quality inhering in a portion of Hair by virtue of its color.
definition_enriched: Hair Color is a Quality that inheres in a portion of Hair by virtue of the color of that portion of Hair.

label: Ideology
definition: An Information Content Entity that consists of a collection of claims about how some part of the world is or should be and which is accepted as true by an Agent or Group of Agents such that it forms the basis of their beliefs, goals, expectations, and motivations.
definition_enriched: An Ideology is an Information Content Entity that consists of a collection of claims about how some part of the world is or should be and that is accepted as true by an Agent or Group of Agents such that it forms the basis of their beliefs, goals, expectations, and motivations.

label: Incorporated Organization
definition: An Organization formed by an Act of Incorporation that consists of an association of individuals, created by law or under authority of law, having a continuous existence independent of the existences of its members and owners, and having powers and liabilities distinct from those of its members and owners.
definition_enriched: An Incorporated Organization is an Organization that is formed by an Act of Incorporation, consists of an association of individuals, is created by law or under the authority of law, has a continuous existence independent of the existences of its members and owners, and has powers and liabilities distinct from those of its members and owners.

label: International Community
definition: A maximal Group of Geopolitical Organizations engaged in geopolitics with one another.
definition_enriched: An International Community is a maximal Group of Geopolitical Organizations that are engaged in geopolitics with one another.

label: Interpersonal Relationship Role
definition: A Role that inheres in a Person in virtue of the obligations, expectations, or social norms that govern that Person's Intentional Acts within the context of a relationship with another Person.
definition_enriched: An Interpersonal Relationship Role is a Role that inheres in a Person in virtue of the obligations, expectations, or social norms that govern that Person's Intentional Acts within the context of a relationship with another Person.

label: Iris
definition: A Bodily Component that consists of the part of an Eye that is a pigmented, round, contractile membrane, suspended between the cornea and lens and perforated by the pupil, and which canonically regulates the amount of light entering the Eye.
definition_enriched: An Iris is a Bodily Component that is the pigmented, round, contractile membrane of an Eye, suspended between the cornea and the lens and perforated by the pupil, and that canonically regulates the amount of light entering the Eye.

label: Language Skill
definition: A Skill that is realized by an Act which is prescribed by a Language.
definition_enriched: A Language Skill is a Skill that is realized by an Act that is prescribed by a Language.

label: Local Administrative Region
definition: A Government Domain that delimits a local Government.
definition_enriched: A Local Administrative Region is a Government Domain that delimits a local Government.

label: Male Sex
definition: A Biological Sex inhering in an individual whose sex organs contain only male gametes.
definition_enriched: Male Sex is a Biological Sex that inheres in an individual whose sex organs contain only male gametes.

label: Material Territory of a Country
definition: The portions of lithosphere, hydrosphere, or atmosphere that together exactly occupy a The Domain of a Country.
definition_enriched: A Material Territory of a Country is those portions of the lithosphere, hydrosphere, or atmosphere that together exactly occupy the Domain of a Country.

label: Material Territory of a Government Domain
definition: The portions of lithosphere, hydrosphere, or atmosphere that together exactly occupy a Government Domain.
definition_enriched: A Material Territory of a Government Domain is those portions of the lithosphere, hydrosphere, or atmosphere that together exactly occupy a Government Domain.

label: Military Personnel Force
definition: An Armed Force authorized to use deadly force, and weapons, to support the interests of the Government and some or all of its Citizens.
definition_enriched: A Military Personnel Force is an Armed Force authorized to use deadly force and weapons to support the interests of the Government and some or all of its Citizens.

label: Neutral Person
definition: A Person who is the bearer of some Neutral Role.
definition_enriched: A Neutral Person is a Person who is the bearer of some Neutral Role.

label: Neutral Role
definition: An Allegiance Role that inheres in an Agent by virtue of that Agent not performing or being committed to performing Acts that have as their Objective to either support or undermine the Objectives of an Agent or Group of Agents involved in some conflict.
definition_enriched: A Neutral Role is an Allegiance Role that inheres in an Agent by virtue of that Agent neither performing nor being committed to performing Acts that have as their Objective to support or to undermine the Objectives of an Agent or Group of Agents involved in some conflict.

label: Nuclear Family
definition: A Family composed of parents and their children.
definition_enriched: A Nuclear Family is a Family that is composed of parents and their children.

label: Objective
definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes some projected state that some Agent intends to achieve.
definition_enriched: An Objective is a Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes some projected state that some Agent intends to achieve.

label: Occupation Role
definition: A Role that inheres in an Agent in virtue of the responsibilities that Agent is expected to fulfill within the context of some Act of Employment.
definition_enriched: An Occupation Role is a Role that inheres in an Agent in virtue of the responsibilities that Agent is expected to fulfill within the context of some Act of Employment.

label: Operational Area
definition: A Geospatial Location in which an Agent conducts some activity.
definition_enriched: An Operational Area is a Geospatial Location in which an Agent conducts some activity.

label: Operator Role
definition: A Role that inheres in an Agent by virtue of that Agent's responsibilities to operate or control some Material Artifact.
definition_enriched: An Operator Role is a Role that inheres in an Agent by virtue of that Agent's responsibilities to operate or control some Material Artifact.

label: Organism
definition: An Object that is an Animal or Plant.
definition_enriched: An Organism is an Object that is an Animal or a Plant.

label: Organization
definition: A Group of Agents which can be the bearer of roles, has members, and has a set of organization rules.
definition_enriched: An Organization is a Group of Agents that can be the bearer of roles, has members, and has a set of organization rules.

label: Organization Capability
definition: An Agent Capability that inheres in an Organization to the extent of that Organization's capacity to realize it in Intentional Acts of a certain type.
definition_enriched: An Organization Capability is an Agent Capability that inheres in an Organization to the extent of that Organization's capacity to realize it in Intentional Acts of a certain type.

label: Organization Member
definition: A Person who is affiliated with some Organization by being a member of that Organization.
definition_enriched: An Organization Member is a Person that is affiliated with some Organization by being a member of that Organization.

label: Organization Member Role
definition: A Role that inheres in an Agent in virtue of the responsibilities that Agent is expected to fulfill as a member of some Organization.
definition_enriched: An Organization Member Role is a Role that inheres in an Agent in virtue of the responsibilities that the Agent is expected to fulfill as a member of some Organization.

label: Paramilitary Force
definition: An Armed Force whose organizational structure, training, subculture, and (often) function are similar to those of a professional Military, and which is not included as part of a Government's formal Armed Forces.
definition_enriched: A Paramilitary Force is an Armed Force whose organizational structure, training, subculture, and often function are similar to those of a professional Military, and which is not included as part of a Government's formal Armed Forces.

label: Permanent Resident
definition: A person with a Permanent Resident Role.
definition_enriched: A Permanent Resident is a person that has a Permanent Resident Role.

label: Permanent Resident Role
definition: A role inhering in a Person by virtue of that Person being recognized as having legal resident status in a Government Domain in which that person is not a citizen but where they have the right to reside on a permanent basis.
definition_enriched: A Permanent Resident Role is a role that inheres in a Person by virtue of that Person being recognized as having legal resident status in a Government Domain in which that Person is not a citizen but has the right to reside on a permanent basis.

label: Person
definition: An Animal that is a member of the species Homo sapiens.
definition_enriched: A Person is an Animal that is a member of the species Homo sapiens.

label: Plan
definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes some set of intended Intentional Acts through which some Agent expects to achieve some Objective.
definition_enriched: A Plan is a Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes some set of intended Intentional Acts through which some Agent expects to achieve some Objective.

label: Plant
definition: An Organism that is multicellular, eukaryotic, autotrophic, and has cells that contain chloroplasts and walls made of cellulose.
definition_enriched: A Plant is an Organism that is multicellular, eukaryotic, and autotrophic and that has cells containing chloroplasts and walls made of cellulose.

label: Political Orientation
definition: An Ideology that characterizes the political thinking of an Agent or Group of Agents, usually with respect to the political environment within a particular nation.
definition_enriched: A Political Orientation is an Ideology that characterizes the political thinking of an Agent or Group of Agents, usually with respect to the political environment within a particular nation.

label: Populace
definition: A Group of Persons forming the total population of some Government Domain.
definition_enriched: A Populace is a Group of Persons that forms the total population of some Government Domain.

label: Process Prohibition
definition: A Process Regulation that prohibits some Process.
definition_enriched: A Process Prohibition is a Process Regulation that prohibits some Process.

label: Process Regulation
definition: A Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes an Process as required, prohibited, or permitted, and is the output of an Process which realizes some Authority Role.
definition_enriched: Process Regulation is a Prescriptive Information Content Entity that prescribes a Process as required, prohibited, or permitted, and is the output of a Process that realizes some Authority Role.

label: Process Requirement
definition: A Process Regulation that requires some Process.
definition_enriched: A Process Requirement is a Process Regulation that requires some Process.

label: Province
definition: A First-Order Administrative Region that is part of a Country and delimits the authority of a magistrate who holds constitutionally-defined administrative jurisdiction over the defined geographic territory that bounds the Province.
definition_enriched: A Province is a First-Order Administrative Region that is part of a Country and delimits the authority of a magistrate who holds constitutionally-defined administrative jurisdiction over the defined geographic territory that bounds the Province.

label: Religion
definition: An Information Content Entity that consists of a collection of claims about the meaning or origin of existence or about the existence or nature of one or more deities, an afterlife, or spiritual or sacred entities, and which is accepted as true by an Agent or Group of Agents.
definition_enriched: A Religion is an Information Content Entity that consists of a collection of claims about the meaning or origin of existence, or about the existence or nature of one or more deities, an afterlife, or spiritual or sacred entities, and that is accepted as true by an Agent or a Group of Agents.

label: Scalp
definition: A Bodily Component that consists of the skin covering the top of the head of a human or other animal.
definition_enriched: A Scalp is a Bodily Component that consists of the skin covering the top of the head of a human or other animal.

label: Scalp Hair
definition: A Bodily Component that consists of a portion of hair that grows on the scalp of a human or other animal.
definition_enriched: Scalp Hair is a Bodily Component that consists of a portion of hair that grows on the scalp of a human or other animal.

label: Scar
definition: A Bodily Component that consists of a portion of fibrous connective tissue on skin or within body tissue and which was formed due to an injury that has not healed completely.
definition_enriched: A Scar is a Bodily Component that consists of a portion of fibrous connective tissue on skin or within body tissue and that was formed due to an injury that has not healed completely.

label: Second-Order Administrative Region
definition: A Government Domain that is a subdivision of a First-Order Administrative Region.
definition_enriched: A Second-Order Administrative Region is a Government Domain that is a subdivision of a First-Order Administrative Region.

label: Service Provider
definition: An Organization whose purpose is to provide a service to other Agents.
definition_enriched: A Service Provider is an Organization whose purpose is to provide a service to other Agents.

label: Set of Eyes
definition: A Bodily Component that consists of two or more Eyes that are part of a single Agent.
definition_enriched: A Set of Eyes is a Bodily Component that consists of two or more Eyes that are part of a single Agent.

label: Skill
definition: An Agent Capability that inheres in a Person to the extent of that Person's capacity to realize it in Intentional Acts of a certain type.
definition_enriched: A Skill is an Agent Capability that inheres in a Person to the extent of that Person's capacity to realize it in Intentional Acts of a certain type.

label: Skin Type
definition: A Quality inhering in a portion of skin by virtue of its color and natural tendency to respond to ultraviolet light.
definition_enriched: Skin Type is a Quality that inheres in a portion of skin by virtue of the color of that portion of skin and its natural tendency to respond to ultraviolet light.

label: Social Network
definition: A Group of Agents that are connected in dyadic relations by similar personal or career interests, activities, backgrounds, or real-life connections.
definition_enriched: A Social Network is a Group of Agents that are connected in dyadic relations by similar personal or career interests, activities, backgrounds, or real-life connections.

label: Tattoo
definition: A Bodily Component that consists of a typically permanent mark or design on a portion of skin that is created by a process of pricking and ingraining an indelible pigment or by raising scars.
definition_enriched: A Tattoo is a Bodily Component that consists of a typically permanent mark or design on a portion of skin created by pricking and ingraining an indelible pigment or by raising scars.

label: Third-Order Administrative Region
definition: A Government Domain that is a subdivision of a Second-Order Administrative Region.
definition_enriched: A Third-Order Administrative Region is a Government Domain that is a subdivision of a Second-Order Administrative Region.

label: Town
definition: A Local Administrative Region in which a human population permanently resides that is typically larger than the population of a Village but smaller than that of a City; is designated as a town based on a particular administrative, legal, or historical status; and which delimits a local Government that typically exercises less power than that of a City Government.
definition_enriched: A town is a Local Administrative Region in which a human population permanently resides, whose population is typically larger than that of a Village and smaller than that of a City, that is designated as a town on the basis of a particular administrative, legal, or historical status, and that delimits a local Government that typically exercises less power than a City Government.

label: Village
definition: A Local Administrative Region in which a human population permanently resides that is typically larger than the population of a hamlet but smaller than that of a Town.
definition_enriched: A Village is a Local Administrative Region in which a human population permanently resides and whose population is typically larger than that of a hamlet but smaller than that of a Town.

label: accessory in
definition: x is_accessory_in y iff x is an instance of Agent and y is an instance of Process such that x assists another instance of Agent z in the commission of y, and x was not located at the location of y when y occurred, and x is not an agent_in y.
definition_enriched: Accessory in is a relation between an agent and a process in which the agent assists another agent in the commission of the process, was not located at the location of the process when the process occurred, and is not an agent in the process.

label: accomplice in
definition: Agent x is accomplice_in Process y iff x assists in the commission of y, is located at the location of y, but is not agent_in y.
definition_enriched: An agent is an accomplice in a process if and only if the agent assists in the commission of the process, is located at the location of the process, and is not an agent in the process.

label: agent in
definition: x agent_in y iff y is an instance of Process and x is an instance of Agent, such that x is causally active in y.
definition_enriched: agent in is a relation between an Agent and a Process such that the Agent is causally active in the Process.

label: aggregate has capability
definition: x aggregate has capability y =Def y capability of aggregate x.
definition_enriched: aggregate has capability is a relation that holds between an aggregate and a capability when the capability is a capability of the aggregate.

label: capability of
definition: x capability_of y iff y is an instance of Agent and x is an instance of Agent Capability, such that x inheres in y.
definition_enriched: capability of is a relation between an Agent Capability and an Agent in which the Agent Capability inheres in the Agent.

label: capability of aggregate
definition: x capability_of_aggregate y iff y is an instance of Object Aggregate and x is an instance of Agent Capability, such that x inheres in aggregate y.
definition_enriched: Capability of aggregate is a relation that holds from an agent capability to an object aggregate in which the agent capability inheres.

label: delimits
definition: x delimits y =Def y is delimited by x.
definition_enriched: delimits is a relation that holds between x and y exactly when y is delimited by x.

label: has accessory
definition: x has accessory y =Def y accessory in x.
definition_enriched: x has accessory y if and only if y is an accessory in x.

label: has accomplice
definition: x has accomplice y =Def y accomplice in x.
definition_enriched: has accomplice is a relation that holds between x and y if and only if y is an accomplice in x.

label: has affiliate
definition: x has affiliate y =Def y is affiliated with x.
definition_enriched: x has affiliate y if and only if y is affiliated with x.

label: has agent
definition: x has agent y =Def y agent in x.
definition_enriched: has agent is a relation that holds between x and y precisely when y is an agent in x.

label: has capability
definition: x has capability y =Def y capability of x.
definition_enriched: has capability is a relation between x and y that holds if and only if y is a capability of x.

label: has interest in
definition: A relation between an Agent and some Process where the Agent has an interest in that Process.
definition_enriched: has interest in is a relation between an Agent and a Process in which the Agent has an interest in that Process.

label: has organizational context
definition: x has organizational context y =Def y is organizational context of x.
definition_enriched: x has organizational context y if and only if y is an organizational context of x.

label: has recipient
definition: x has recipient y =Def y receives x.
definition_enriched: has recipient is a binary relation that holds between x and y if and only if y receives x.

label: has sender
definition: x has sender y =Def y sends x.
definition_enriched: has sender is a relation that holds between x and y if and only if y sends x.

label: has subordinate role
definition: x has subordinate role y =Def y is subordinate role to x.
definition_enriched: has subordinate role is a binary relation that holds between x and y if and only if y is a subordinate role to x.

label: has subsidiary
definition: x has subsidiary y =Def y is subsidiary of x.
definition_enriched: x has subsidiary y if and only if y is subsidiary of x.

label: is affiliated with
definition: x is_affiliated_with y iff x and y are instances of Agent, such that they have any kind of social or business relationship.
definition_enriched: is affiliated with is a relation that holds between two agents when they have any kind of social or business relationship.

label: is delimited by
definition: x is_delimited_by y iff x is an instance of Organization and y is an instance of Delimiting Domain and y delimits x.
definition_enriched: is delimited by is a relation between an Organization and a Delimiting Domain that holds if and only if the Delimiting Domain delimits the Organization.

label: is interest of
definition: x is interest of y =Def y has interest in x.
definition_enriched: x is interest of y if and only if y has interest in x.

label: is organizational context of
definition: x is_organizational_context_of y iff x is an instance of an Organization and y is an instance of a Role and z is an instance of a Person, such that z's affiliation with x is a prerequisite for z bearing y, or x ascribes y to the bearer of y.
definition_enriched: x is organizational context of y if and only if x is an Organization and y is a Role, and either a Person’s affiliation with x is a prerequisite for that Person bearing y, or x ascribes y to the bearer of y.

label: is permitted by
definition: x is permitted by y =Def y permits x.
definition_enriched: is permitted by is a relation that holds between x and y if and only if y permits x.

label: is prohibited by
definition: x is prohibited by y =Def y prohibits x.
definition_enriched: is prohibited by is a relation that holds between x and y exactly when y prohibits x.

label: is required by
definition: x is required by y =Def y requires x.
definition_enriched: is required by is a relation that holds between x and y if and only if y requires x.

label: is subordinate role to
definition: For all x,y,t: y is subordinate role to x at t iff: x is an instance of Role at time t, and y is an instance of Role at time t, and there is some z such that x is realized by z and z is an instance of Process which creates, modifies, transfers, or eliminates some u such that u is a Process Regulation at time t, and u is addressed to the bearer of y.
definition_enriched: y is subordinate role to x at time t if and only if x is an instance of Role at t, y is an instance of Role at t, and some process realizing x creates, modifies, transfers, or eliminates a process regulation that is an instance of Process Regulation at t and is addressed to the bearer of y.

label: is subsidiary of
definition: x is_subsidiary_of y iff x and y are both instances of Organization and y controls x by having the capacity to determine the outcome of decisions about the financial and operating policies of x.
definition_enriched: is subsidiary of is a relation that holds between two instances of Organization, from the controlled organization to the controlling organization, when the controlling organization controls the controlled organization by having the capacity to determine the outcome of decisions about the financial and operating policies of the controlled organization.

label: is supervised by
definition: x is_supervised_by y iff x and y are both instances of Person and y supervises x.
definition_enriched: A relation that holds between two persons if and only if the second supervises the first.

label: is used by
definition: x is used by y =Def y uses x.
definition_enriched: is used by is a relation that holds between x and y if and only if y uses x.

label: permits
definition: x permits y at t iff: x is an instance of Process Regulation at time t, and y is an instance of Process at time t, and x prescribes that y may occur.
definition_enriched: x permits y at a time t if and only if x is an instance of Process Regulation at t, y is an instance of Process at t, and x prescribes that y may occur.

label: prohibits
definition: x prohibits y at t iff: x is an instance of Process Regulation at time t, and y is an instance of Process at time t, and x prescribes that some y must not occur.
definition_enriched: A process regulation prohibits a process at a time if and only if the process regulation prescribes that the process must not occur.

label: receives
definition: x receives y iff x is an instance of Agent and y is an instance of Act Of Communication, such that x is the recipient and decoder of the InformationContentEntity intended for communication in y.
definition_enriched: receives is a relation between an agent and an act of communication such that the agent is the recipient and decoder of the information content entity intended for communication in that act.

label: requires
definition: x requires y at t iff: x is an instance of Process Regulation at time t, and y is an instance of Process at time t, and x prescribes that some y must occur.
definition_enriched: requires is a relation between a Process Regulation and a Process at a time such that the Process Regulation prescribes that the Process must occur.

label: sends
definition: x sends y iff x is an instance of Agent and y is an instance of Act Of Communication, such that x is the initiator and encoder of the InformationContentEntity intended for communication in y.
definition_enriched: sends is a relation between an agent and an act of communication in which the agent is the initiator and encoder of the information content entity intended for communication in that act of communication.

label: supervises
definition: x supervises y =Def y is supervised by x.
definition_enriched: supervises is a relation that holds between x and y if and only if y is supervised by x.

label: uses
definition: x uses y iff x is an instance of an Agent and y is an instance of a Material Entity, such that both x and y participate in some instance of a Process wherein x attempts to accomplish a goal by manipulating, deploying, or leveraging some attribute of y.
definition_enriched: uses is a relation between an Agent and a Material Entity that holds if and only if both participate in a Process in which the Agent attempts to accomplish a goal by manipulating, deploying, or leveraging some attribute of the Material Entity.
